title: Hindsight Structured Advice Distillation: Steering Executor Agents with Advisors Trained on Their Failures and Task Characteristics
abstract: arXiv:2610.13000v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language-model agents are used for specialized work such as financial research, healthcare and law. Such agents are often capable enough for a task but still miss its details. In finance, for example, these details include which filing reports a figure or how a company discloses a metric. Retraining the agent to learn these details is expensive, and often impossible when the agent is a closed or shared system. Writing the missing know-how into the agent's prompt makes the prompt long and identical for every input, although different inputs need different guidance. We propose to learn to generate this guidance instead. A small advisor model reads each input and writes structured advice, which is appended to the prompt of a frozen executor. The advisor is trained with hindsight, following work on distillation with privileged information. translated_title: 后见之明结构化建议蒸馏：利用基于执行智能体失败与任务特征训练的顾问模型来引导执行智能体
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体被应用于金融研究、医疗健康和法律等专业领域的工作。这类智能体通常已具备完成任务的能力，但仍会遗漏其中的细节。例如在金融领域，这些细节包括某个数字出自哪份申报文件，或一家公司如何披露某项指标。重新训练智能体来学习这些细节成本高昂，且当智能体是封闭或共享系统时往往无法实现。而将缺失的专业知识写入智能体的提示词，会使提示词冗长且对每个输入都完全相同，尽管不同输入需要不同的指导。我们转而提出学习生成这种指导。一个小型顾问模型读取每个输入并撰写结构化建议，该建议被附加到冻结的执行器提示词之后。顾问模型借鉴基于特权信息进行蒸馏的相关工作，通过后见之明（hindsight）方式进行训练。在一个带有分级答案的训练池上，我们分析执行器的失败情况，在多种策略下运行它……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出后见之明结构化建议蒸馏方法，训练一个小型顾问模型分析冻结执行智能体的失败案例与任务特征，为每个输入动态生成结构化建议并附加到其提示词中，从而以低成本弥补专业任务中细节知识的缺失。
en_tdlr: A small advisor model trained in hindsight on the frozen executor agent's failures and task characteristics dynamically generates input-specific structured advice appended to the executor's prompt, compensating for missing task details without costly retraining.
